title: Scolopen
summary: Scolopen is a Swara-Titan that resembles a cross between a centipede and a barbarian warrior. Though Scolopen Titans are not very strong, they work hard and are easy to summon as a group.

sections.heading: History
sections.wikitext:
Though most Swara-Titans are used by evil [[Seekers]], the strange Scolopen Titans are a favorite among many [[Huntik Foundation]] operatives. {{Source|Huntik.com}}

One [[Suit]] was particularly intimidated by Scolopen's appearance, notably his spiked club and scary centipede head. {{source|SAS-069}}

sections.heading: Abilities
sections.wikitext:
Scolopen is a battle-ready Titan who fights with a shield and a spiked club. In addition, Scolopen can create clones of himself and works well with other Scolopen Titans.

'''Scolopen''' is a [[Swara-Titan]] that resembles a cross between a centipede and a barbarian warrior. Though Scolopen [[Titans]] are not very strong, they work hard and are easy to summon as a group.

== History ==
Though most Swara-Titans are used by evil [[Seekers]], the strange Scolopen Titans are a favorite among many [[Huntik Foundation]] operatives. {{Source|Huntik.com}}

One [[Suit]] was particularly intimidated by Scolopen's appearance, notably his spiked club and scary centipede head. {{source|SAS-069}}

== Abilities ==
Scolopen is a battle-ready Titan who fights with a shield and a spiked club. In addition, Scolopen can create clones of himself and works well with other Scolopen Titans.
